name: Tuner garage (experimental)
author: OpenTDU2
description: Adds a tuner garage to the game: a map spot on every island where the tuner-style cars (GT-R, 370Z, 350Z, Impreza WRX STI, RX-8, Delta Integrale, Escort RS Cosworth) get visual parts the vanilla game never had. First parts: spoilers (a GT wing, a ducktail, a street lip), shown live on your car and saved per car. Leave it off for the vanilla experience: no garage, no parts - and parts you already bought stay saved, untouched, until you turn the mod back on.
